text: Roake serves as the Ranger logistics officer and primary pilot of a 3-person Marshal Ranger crew within the galactic_union faction (org_union_marshals).

Frontier Enforcement Escalation Study (sim capture): conducted field resupply during live engagements without halting momentum (homing carrier drone + high-speed porter drones, incl. Viper modifications); retained control over timing, routing, and prioritization; received Cross's 3D battlefield imagery for analysis.
Third crew member supporting the Cross/Vorn field pair; operates the Ranger gunboat as command hub and resupply origin.
Ranger gunboat systems: autopilot, wing-embedded 360-degree quad turrets (human-AI cooperative), drone complement (carrier, porter, and per 2026-07-21 doctrine the wider RFD family).
